_description: qutebrowser keybindings. Mode → key → command. Maps to home-manager's programs.qutebrowser.keyBindings.<mode> attrset.

normal._comment_autofill: Hotkeys to fire the system autofill daemon directly from a qutebrowser focus context. Browser is just a 'focused window' to the daemon — these hotkeys are the explicit, in-browser ergonomic path on top of the global system hotkey. The trailing arg (pick|user|pass|totp) is the binary's action selector: 'pick' shows the interactive action picker, the others dispatch that action directly and skip the picker. Use 'spawn --detach' (NOT --userscript): the target is a standalone GUI helper, not a qutebrowser userscript that talks back over $QUTE_FIFO.
